detailed_descriptions.en: This is a first-person organization simulation game where you shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive. Game Modes Solo, together, or competition... Enjoy the different game modes: Single player, online co-op, and online PvP. You can also try "Sandbox Mode", where all your skills are unlocked and always ready to use, or "No-Skill Mode" to challenge yourself. Videotape Categories Your task is to shelve 3,180 videotapes into the correct categories in the archive. Action movies, drama movies, TV series, cartoons, horror movies, comedy movies, athletic games, football cups, romance movies, sci-fi movies, baseball, tennis, news, game shows, basketball, motorsport, cooking shows, documentaries, boxing, and talk shows. Skills Sorting Numerically: Sorts the videotapes in your hand in numerical order Highlighting Shelf: Highlights the correct shelf for the topmost videotape in your hand Highlighting Videotapes: Highlights the same videotapes as the topmost videotape in your hand Auto-Placement: Automatically places your videotapes on the shelf in the correct order Auto-Collect: Automatically collects the same videotapes as the topmost videotape in your hand

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
This is a first-person organization simulation game where you shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive.

Game Modes

Solo, together, or competition...

Enjoy the different game modes: Single player, online co-op, and online PvP.

You can also try "Sandbox Mode", where all your skills are unlocked and always ready to use, or "No-Skill Mode" to challenge yourself.

Videotape Categories

Your task is to shelve 3,180 videotapes into the correct categories in the archive.

Action movies, drama movies, TV series, cartoons, horror movies, comedy movies, athletic games, football cups, romance movies, sci-fi movies, baseball, tennis, news, game shows, basketball, motorsport, cooking shows, documentaries, boxing, and talk shows.

Skills

  • Sorting Numerically: Sorts the videotapes in your hand in numerical order

  • Highlighting Shelf: Highlights the correct shelf for the topmost videotape in your hand

  • Highlighting Videotapes: Highlights the same videotapes as the topmost videotape in your hand

  • Auto-Placement: Automatically places your videotapes on the shelf in the correct order

  • Auto-Collect: Automatically collects the same videotapes as the topmost videotape in your hand
